title: Refusal to Eat
situation: Mom hasn't eaten anything all day. She pushes the plate away and says the food is bad. I've tried three different meals. I'm worried about her nutrition.

patient_profile.name: Rose
behavioral_patterns: used to love cooking Italian food

notes: Should mention taste changes in dementia. Suggest small portions, colorful plates, finger foods. Must NOT force-feed or argue about eating.
